passive.name: Departing Anew
passive.text: After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate on one ally character, the wearer regenerates **6/6.5/7/7.5/8** Energy and the ability's target receives 1 stack of "Hymn" for **3** turn(s), stacking up to **3** time(s). Each stack of "Hymn" increases its holder's DMG dealt by **15/17.25/19.5/21.75/24%**. After every **2** instance(s) of Skill or Ultimate the wearer uses on one ally character, recovers 1 Skill Point.

passive.name: Heir
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **10/12/14/16/18%** and regenerates 1 Skill Point when the wearer uses their Ultimate on an ally. This effect can be triggered once after every 2 uses of the wearer's Ultimate. When the wearer uses their Skill, the next ally taking action (except the wearer) deals **30/35/40/45/50%** more DMG for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Kites From the Past
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Skill, the next ally taking action (except the wearer) deals **16/20/24/28/32%** increased DMG for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Cannot Stop It!
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

substatLine: SPD (Until desired speed build) > CRIT DMG > EFF RES% > DEF% = HP%
tracePriority: Rest Day's Longing (A2) > Exalted Sweep (A4) > Haven in Palm (A6)

entries.name: Gleaming Admonition
entries.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to **100%** of Sunday's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Benison of Paper and Rites
entries.text:
Enables one designated ally character and their summon to immediately take action, and increases their DMG dealt by **30%**. If the target has a summon, then the DMG Boost effect is further boosted by an additional **50%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).
After using Skill on The Beatified, recovers 1 Skill Point.
When Sunday uses this ability on characters following the Path of Harmony, cannot trigger the "immediate action" effect.

entries.name: Ode to Caress and Cicatrix
entries.text:
Regenerates Energy by **20%** of Max Energy for one designated ally character, and turns the target and their summon into "The Beatified." "The Beatified" have their CRIT DMG increased by an amount equal to **30%** of Sunday's CRIT DMG plus **12%**.
At the start of Sunday's every turn, the duration of "The Beatified" decreases by 1 turn, lasting for a total of **3** turn(s). And it only takes effect on the most recent target of the Ultimate (excluding Sunday himself). When Sunday is knocked down, "The Beatified" will also be dispelled.

entries.name: The Sorrowing Body
entries.text: When using Skill, increases the target's CRIT Rate by **20%**, lasting for **3** turn(s).

entries.name: The Glorious Mysteries
entries.text: After this Technique is used, the first time Sunday uses an ability on an ally target in the next battle, the target's DMG dealt increases by **50%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Rest Day's Longing
entries.text: When using Ultimate, if the Energy regenerated for the target is less than **40**, increases the regenerated Energy to **40**.

entries.name: Exalted Sweep
entries.text: When battle starts, Sunday regenerates **25** Energy.

entries.name: Haven in Palm
entries.text: When using Skill, dispels **1** debuff(s) from the target.

entries.name: Millennium's Quietus
entries.text: When Sunday uses Skill, the target character can ignore 16% of enemy target's DEF to deal DMG and their summon can ignore 40% of enemy target's DEF to deal DMG, lasting for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Faith Outstrips Frailty
entries.text: After the first use of Ultimate, recovers 2 Skill Point(s). The DMG dealt by "The Beatified" increases by 30%.

entries.name: Hermitage of Thorns
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Sculpture's Preamble
entries.text: When the turn starts, regenerates 8 Energy.

entries.name: Paper Raft in Silver Bay
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Dawn of Sidereal Cacophony
entries.text: The Talent's CRIT Rate boost effect becomes stackable up to 3 time(s), and the Talent's duration increases by 1 turn(s). When Sunday uses Ultimate, can also apply the Talent's CRIT Rate boost effect to the target. When the Talent's CRIT Rate boost takes effect and the target's CRIT Rate exceeds 100%, every 1% of excess CRIT Rate increases CRIT DMG by 2%.
